meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，代码编辑会触发注释检查。若有警告，Claude 会停下，要求修复或解释被标记的注释，然后才继续。非编辑操作忽略，检查器缺失则无输出。
howto.when: 在 Claude 成功完成 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作后自动触发。非编辑操作不触发。

say.note: Claude 会修改该注释以通过检查。

say.text: 解释为何这条注释被警告。
say.note: Claude 会分析并说明原因。

howto.what_en: After successful edit-like actions, Claude runs a comment check. Warnings block progress until Claude fixes or explains the flagged comment. Non-edit tools are ignored; missing checker binaries cause no output.
howto.when_en: Triggered after successful edit calls such as apply_patch, write, edit, etc. Non-edit tools are ignored.

say_en.note: Claude updates the comment to satisfy the checker.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment is flagged.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes and gives the reason.
